description: This is a PHP test class for the UserLocation model in the Goteo project, containing unit tests for user location behaviors such as creation, validation, persistence, and proximity features.

classes.name: UserLocationTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the UserLocation model, covering creation, validation, save, location properties, proximity searches, and enable/disable locatability.

methods.name: testInstance
methods.description: Creates a UserLocation object and verifies it is an instance of the class.

methods.name: testDefaultValidation
methods.description: Checks that the default UserLocation instance validation fails and that saving does not succeed.

methods.name: testAddUserLocation
methods.description: Creates a UserLocation with predefined data and verifies its properties.

methods.name: testSaveUserLocationNonUser
methods.description: Attempts to save a UserLocation not associated with a user, expecting failure.

methods.name: testCreateUser
methods.description: Associates a UserLocation with a test user and verifies user object creation.

methods.name: testSaveUserLocation
methods.description: Validates and saves a UserLocation, then verifies retrieval and property consistency.

methods.name: testSetLocable
methods.description: Marks a UserLocation as locable, verifies the change, and checks quantities of locable locations.

methods.name: testSetProperty
methods.description: Sets a custom property ('info') on a UserLocation and verifies the change.

methods.name: testNearbyEmpty
methods.description: Checks proximity search on a location with no nearby locations, expecting an empty array.

methods.name: testAddSecondUser
methods.description: Creates a second user with a nearby location to test proximity search functionality.

methods.name: testNearby
methods.description: Verifies that nearby users are correctly identified within a certain distance.

methods.name: testRemoveLocationEntry
methods.description: Deletes a UserLocation entry and verifies it no longer exists.
